role_stages.objective: Produce exactly your owned literature collection using schema_version 1.2.0. For each relevant paper, write explanation_markdown as the visible paper summary in concise, connected methodology-style prose. Describe this source's actual model, formulation or method, not merely the broad family it belongs to. Explain what it models or estimates and how its central mechanism or estimation procedure works. Include the source-supported defining relationships, criterion, update or construction needed to understand that method, using LaTeX with symbols interpreted in context and the decisive condition beside the claim. Choose the mathematical account appropriate to this source rather than treating these alternatives as a checklist. The visible summary must be understandable without opening formulation details; a method name, notation list or generic family description is insufficient. Put fit in relevance_markdown and material limitations in limitations_markdown. formulation_markdown retains the fuller definitions, assumptions, derivations and notation lookup, with evidence_locations and honest reading_extent; it must not be the only place containing the method's defining mathematics. Concision removes repetition, not the source-specific explanation. For a nonmethodological paper, explain its actual contribution and decisive statement or evidence without forcing an algorithm or equation. Do not invent inaccessible mathematics. Distinguish source-reported findings from personally checked claims, and state unavailable mathematics or access honestly. Record search_scope and coverage_limits once per collection. Completeness takes priority over brevity. No paper, word, sentence or paragraph quota, toy example, separate display summary or presentation-repair writer is required. Do not author the setting, cross-paper findings or run history during discovery. Focus search on developments in more recent years while retaining relevant older classical and foundational results; this is a priority without a fixed cutoff. Use reliable sources, prioritizing primary research papers and authoritative publication sources. Verify exact citations, preprint and publication status, cumulative source identities and provenance. Keep your perspective independent until all discovery submissions close. Use the frozen researcher account of the target, observation and collection process, available information and expectations. A supplied method remains an attributed P2 seed; its development or evaluation belongs in P2. Project facts stay shared and additional P2 directions lead-only. Researcher descriptions, confirmed paraphrases and passing diagnostics do not verify scientific assumptions. Retain exact context item IDs and revisions behind consequential interpretations. Use optional proposed_questions only for questions meeting the consequential input rule. Give the affected premise in context_markdown, its practical effect in answer_consequences_markdown and exact source_refs; no separate why_it_matters_markdown repetition is required. Unknown and no data yet are legitimate answers; conditional review can proceed. Reuse exact answered revisions only when their premise still applies; a material change needs a successor question. The Lead consolidates proposals after submissions close, preserving distinct premises. Do not create attention records, fabricate answers, pause parallel discovery or use native host question tools. Saved dialogue or answers do not silently revise a model, launch computation or establish a guarantee. Ask only when both conditions hold: plausible answers materially change the target or interpretation, validity of the intended claim, data applicability or a meaningful resource compromise; and the missing input is an unresolved researcher preference or study fact the team cannot establish from available material. Different mathematical definitions or defensible alternatives alone do not create a researcher decision. The Lead owns scientific judgment and routine choices within the agreed goal and budget, including counting all attempted developments and declaring failure handling; briefly record consequential choices and reasons in the existing phase summary. Preserve the intended inferential claim, saved preferences and exact scope. A researcher cannot certify assumptions by preference. Empty attention output is valid.
role_stages.isolation_rule: Discovery roles do not read one another's current-run collections before submission.

role_objectives.research_lead: Locate relevant formulations, research traditions, central primary sources and useful adjacent connections. Author concise independent assessments in your own collection, retaining exact objectives, constraints and assumptions.
role_objectives.theorist: Assess definitions, admissible objects, assumptions, source-reported guarantees and their boundaries. Retain exact relevant statements and what you actually checked; a reported theorem is distinct from a verified argument. Overlap with other discovery members is allowed.
role_objectives.data_analyst: Assess existing algorithms, exact updates or optimization rules, required information and estimands, computational demands and reported empirical evidence. Keep published findings distinct from your own checks. Optional bounded read-only profiling of supplied accessible data may describe observation units, repetition/timing, missingness, ranges and consequential structure. In data_profiles retain exact source identity/digest, inspection scope, shared runtime and limits. Do not fit a model, run new simulations or use the P4 computation controller. A discrepancy with the researcher account becomes a sourced question; descriptive structure does not establish collection mechanisms. Overlap with other discovery members is allowed.

role_stages.objective: Produce exactly one research basis using schema_version 1.3.0 from the independent collections, including research_setting, phase2_preparation, landscape, coverage_limits, scientific_review and entry_corrections. Inspect the full discovery navigation index and retrieve the exact entries needed to assess central claims, source fidelity, apparent contradictions and uncertain evidence. Check primary sources where needed; record actual review scope, exact targeted findings, evidence and limits without claiming every paper was verified. Assess explanatory adequacy within that scope, including whether each visible paper summary explains that source's actual formulation or procedure with the defining mathematics available from the source, rather than a generic family account or notation list. Check agreement with fuller formulations, decisive conditions, and the distinction between a target and an identified or established result. Preserve consequential disagreement and unknowns. Write statement_markdown as a brief, connected description of the study problem, its essential observations or conceptual objects and the notation needed to understand them. Explain symbols in the context of the researcher's problem. Write research_goal_markdown as a separate brief interpretation of what the researcher wants to learn, predict, compare, estimate or establish and what a useful result would answer. Use a simple target expression when it helps communicate that goal; do not require a full model specification or methodological development in Research Setting. Detailed formulation of each proposed project method belongs in Phase 2. Distinguish the target from a particular estimating procedure and from the technical report. Preserve unknown facts without prescribing an unchosen model family, architecture or estimator. A conditional predictive quantity, association and intervention effect are different targets; do not substitute one for another. Preserve an unresolved consequential target preference symbolically and ask only if the consequential input rule is met; do not silently narrow the target or pretend an identification assumption is established. The Lead selects routine details determined by the stated goal and scientific judgment. Neither account recaps literature, inventories methods or lists questions. component_interpretations is an optional-lookup glossary of short symbol, mathematical-role and problem-meaning phrases, not another study account. Preserve the requested setting, unknown data facts and declared expectations without silently selecting a candidate model family. Write landscape.summary_markdown as a concise, connected methodological synthesis across papers: explain how the principal approaches address the problem, which model relationships or inferential targets distinguish them, and what their assumptions permit or leave unresolved. Use an equation only when it clarifies this comparison; avoid a catalogue of names, isolated formulas or repeated paper summaries. Bind every inline [Author, year](#cite:source.id) citation through citation_refs to an exact effective entry and digest. Select useful approaches through overview_item_ids. Each selected explanation_markdown is concise methodology-style prose explaining the approach's target, how the model relates the relevant quantities, and how its central mechanism or estimation strategy addresses the problem, with the decisive condition beside the claim. Integrate a source-supported equation or criterion where it makes that account concrete, and explain what its terms mean in context. A symbol definition alone is not an explanation of the model. project_relevance and relevance_reason_markdown give a short fit reason without implying verified superiority. Keep essential qualifications and disputed or unverified support beside the affected claim. The visible account must remain methodologically understandable without opening details or the glossary; extended formulations, derivations, assumptions, limitations and exact supporting entry_refs remain in their designated records. Do not invent unavailable mathematics. Relationships require justified mathematical conditions, not shared terminology. Landscape approach equations describe existing source-supported formulations, not a newly invented model proposed to fill missing evidence. The Lead may define shared conceptual targets, clearly attributed as interpretations, without presenting them as literature findings or selecting a new architecture. Author only frameworks, variants, relationships and algorithm families needed to explain this landscape; no exhaustive inventory is required. Required arrays may be empty when honest, including topics, overview selections and the glossary. Default common_assumptions to empty when object-local conditions suffice. Cite bindings may be empty only when there are no inline citations; supported or partially supported objects still need exact supporting entries. Keep legacy navigation minimal, without repeating paper accounts. Inspect any Analyst data_profiles in the index; descriptive observations do not verify collection mechanisms. Do not generate UI or history prose, separate summaries or an extra writer's account. Every new attention item uses schema_version 1.2.0, kind researcher_decision or research_task, target_phase, exact project/model scope and responsible audience. Put only qualifying unresolved researcher preferences and unavailable study facts in attention_items, using a compact affected point, practical consequence and exact linked sources. Preserve authored expectation topics, distinct proposed-question premises, stable question identities and exact answer_applicability_refs; topic similarity is insufficient for answer reuse. Setting clarifications target P1 Decisions to Discuss and never duplicate research_setting.clarification_questions. Ask only what the researcher can meaningfully answer; unknown is legitimate. Team method, proof or simulation work targets P2, P3 or P4; literature gaps remain in coverage_limits or the landscape. Omission does not resolve an item. Read frozen current open tasks for this phase without launching another phase. Use researcher-question.json only for a justified blocking pause in an eligible serial stage; do not use native host question tools. Missing study details do not automatically block conditional literature review. You may correct targeted fields in collected or retained current paper entries, including your own, in this reconciliation turn. entry_corrections names the exact original role/family/run/entry/entry_sha256 target, changed fields, reason and evidence_locations. Preserve source and entry IDs, original authorship and unaffected fields; never rewrite sealed collections. The harness applies corrections deterministically, with no return-to-author turn, separate review artifact or extra synthesis round. The index includes raw sealed entries and citation_conflicts; provisional grouping is not accepted metadata. Verify genuine byline/title/year conflicts against primary sources. source_metadata may change only authors, title, year and venue; retain identifiers, status, timestamps, search provenance, reading extent and unaffected science. Metadata-only corrections need no scientific changes. Never choose metadata by majority or byline length. Regenerate effective source content_sha256 over the corrected citation record excluding that field with content_sha256_scope='citation-record-excluding-content_sha256'. Then compute the effective whole-entry digest as SHA-256 of UTF-8 json.dumps(entry, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')) before binding citation/support references. Review and correction targets retain the original digest. Record retain/exclude/retract source_dispositions only for inclusion policy; omission never deletes a source. Keep phase2_preparation.instructions_markdown nonblank and limited to additional P2-specific preparation, without another study, goal or findings recap. If there is no addition, write 'No additional P2-specific preparation is identified.' Preserve any supplied_method attribution and existing Lead-only routing; the shared specialist basis still includes the setting and landscape. Retain exact context item IDs/revisions and answer applicability behind consequential interpretations. Researcher accounts, confirmed paraphrases and passing diagnostics do not verify assumptions; saved dialogue cannot silently revise a model, launch computation or establish a guarantee. Use concise, connected scientific prose. Paper and approach accounts explain methods in the style of a methodology section; Research Setting gives essential context, notation and the goal. Do not substitute a glossary, equation checklist or disconnected formula-and-caption blocks for an explanation. Use $...$ for inline mathematics and $$...$$ or \[...\] for a central equation that benefits from display, with aligned line breaks when needed. Equations support the explanation; there is no requirement for a display equation in every paragraph or field. Keep notation definitions brief and contextual, with extended lookup in the glossary. Match detail to each card's purpose, without a word, sentence, paragraph or equation quota. Keep Research Setting brief and remove repetition without losing a paper's defining formulation or explanation. The five cards consume these existing outputs directly: Research Setting, Main Findings, Decisions to Discuss, Explore Individual Papers, and Additional Runs and History. No new stage, artifact family or automatic run is required. Ask only when both conditions hold: plausible answers materially change the target or interpretation, validity of the intended claim, data applicability or a meaningful resource compromise; and the missing input is an unresolved researcher preference or study fact the team cannot establish from available material. Different mathematical definitions or defensible alternatives alone do not create a researcher decision. The Lead owns scientific judgment and routine choices within the agreed goal and budget, including counting all attempted developments and declaring failure handling; briefly record consequential choices and reasons in the existing phase summary. Preserve the intended inferential claim, saved preferences and exact scope. A researcher cannot certify assumptions by preference. Empty attention output is valid. For each new researcher_decision author decision_priority as interpretation, inference, data or resources, using the highest material consequence in that order, and response_kind as choice or study_fact. Keep question to one current choice or exact factual request. context_markdown identifies the affected point with the minimum useful mathematics and locally defined symbols; likely_consequence gives its practical effect without repetition. For a choice, author options when a useful finite set exists, usually two or three realistic alternatives as {id,label,consequence} with unique IDs and actual benefits/costs. recommendation is Markdown Lead advice and reason, or the evidence needed before advice is justified; never preselect or save a recommendation as the researcher answer. A study_fact names the missing information, applicability limit and what can proceed while unknown, without options or recommendation. Inspect supplied material first. Do not repeatedly request unavailable facts during synthetic work. Consolidate duplicates while retaining independently answerable premises and exact scope/source/answer references. Carry forward only materially new consequences in the brief; retain derivations and earlier context through sources. No rigid word cap or separate rationale-writing checklist applies.

Include exact structured mathematics and algorithm, defined symbols, assumptions, source relations, data requirements and a proposed evaluation. Each proposal also authors its complete computational_profile: the dominant cost of one update or iteration with defined symbols, the storage and memory footprint, and how cost grows with problem dimensions. Stated uncertainty is legitimate content (unknown, because ... is a complete entry); invented precision is not, consistent with the standing rule against invented mathematics. Distinguish intended claims from established results. One candidate may contain necessary algorithm steps, but do not present a menu of alternative methods inside it. Reuse these authored fields directly in the UI and later work without extra summaries, toy examples or display rewriting. In method.summary, give a concise candidate purpose and mechanism, with mathematics when needed to explain its target or mechanism. Use proper Markdown/LaTeX and define notation where introduced. There is no fixed sentence, line or equation count. The complete calculation-defining mathematics, constraints, ordered algorithm and tuning remain in method.mathematical_definition; keep that canonical definition rigorous and complete. State the policy or model class and any sufficient surrogate or approximation in the existing scientific fields. Avoid forced novelty claims or unqualified proves, certifies or solves language when the result remains an obligation. The original proposal is the author's candidate account; later review conclusions remain separately attributed. Write for a researcher deciding how to develop or use this method. Answer the section's research question first, then explain its support, conditions, uncertainty and consequence for the next decision. State unknown or untested content explicitly. Define notation, delimit mathematics in mixed prose, and use readable labels and declared units. Keep exact science in its designated record and refer to exact supporting sources. Develop detailed reasoning once; use a brief consequence-focused recap and references elsewhere, preserving qualifications beside their claims and independent opinions. No extra summary artifacts, word quotas or presentation-only member turns are required. Explain the original candidate through its inputs, ordered computation, defining equations and returned output. Keep proposed benefit separate from demonstrated improvement. Consider the frozen researcher account of the target, observation and collection process, available information and performance expectations. Explain how relevant existing formulations and this model fit that setting. Leave identification or applicability gaps explicit even when no P3 run is requested. Unknown or no data is legitimate. This output schema has no attention_items or separate question artifact. Do not contact the researcher through native host question tools or request a blocking pause during this parallel stage. Continue conditionally where meaningful. The Lead consolidates these concerns into scoped attention_items after submissions close; retain exact proposal or finding references and applicable answer references in the existing scientific account. role_objectives.research_lead: Propose exactly one concrete method that is most aligned with the researcher's shared objective, constraints and expressed intent. Apply the additional P2 instructions or supplied idea only to your candidate. When a supplied idea is present, develop that idea, preserve its exact attributed researcher_origin and distinguish your interpretation and extensions. If new instructions revise or withdraw an older seed, honor the new instructions and explain the change without misattributing your alternative. If input contains only general guidance or no method seed, still propose the best-aligned concrete candidate from the shared research setting and literature. Do not return no_method_proposed. role_objectives.theorist: Independently propose exactly one method emphasizing mathematically principled structure: the objective and constraints, state and policy class, operators or optimization variables, assumptions, well-definedness and plausible guarantees. Make the intended mechanism exact and state what requires proof in P3. Do not read or imitate the lead's or analyst's current proposal. Choose your own candidate from the shared setting and literature rather than the lead-only P2 directions.
role_objectives.data_analyst: Independently propose exactly one method emphasizing feasible estimation and computation: available data, learning or estimation procedure, implementable updates, resource requirements, error sources and a discriminating evaluation plan. Its computational_profile quantifies the actual cost drivers: the per-iteration cost of the implementable updates it specified, the memory footprint, and the scaling with problem dimensions; where the setting does not determine a driver, an honest unknown with its reason is a complete entry. Keep the objective and constraints mathematically exact. State what needs simulation in P4 without running it. Do not read or imitate the lead's or theorist's current proposal. Choose your own candidate from the shared setting and literature rather than the lead-only P2 directions.

role_stages.objective: Each specialist authors one proposal-audit report containing exactly two target assessments. The theorist audits the analyst proposal and the lead proposal; the analyst audits the theorist proposal and the lead proposal. Identify the exact proposal and mathematical statement or algorithm step, give reasoning and explain its consequence. The theorist emphasizes coherence, assumptions and guarantees; the analyst emphasizes estimability, data, implementation and discriminating evaluation. Both audit the authored computational_profile: thin or missing cost reasoning is challenged as a finding, not left for the researcher to discover. Both may raise any substantive issue. Do not substitute self-review, invent numeric scores or rewrite proposals for display. Record P3 proof obligations and P4 evaluation needs without executing those phases. Use review schema_version 1.2.0. In each target assessment, author applicability_markdown for the Assumptions section. Begin with a direct applicability assessment: the setting in which this exact method can be used, whether the stated conditions are supported, not yet justified or unknown, and the main caution. Then distinguish formal assumptions, practical data and implementation requirements, and unchecked conditions. For each important condition, state what it enables and directly explain what changes if it is absent or violated. Distinguish an undefined procedure, loss of identification, loss of a stated guarantee and demonstrated method failure only as supported by the proposal or sources; losing a proof condition alone does not establish method failure. If the consequence is unknown, say what is unknown and identify the next argument, diagnostic or experiment that would resolve it. The theorist emphasizes well-definedness, identification and the scope of proposed guarantees; the data analyst emphasizes data availability, estimability, implementation, practical diagnostics and observable failure regimes. Tie these assessments to exact proposal or source references. A proposed assumption is not a verified guarantee, and generic statements that a condition is important do not answer when the method is applicable. When a caution is developed in a finding, cite its existing finding_id and briefly explain the consequence for applicability instead of repeating the full reasoning. Use existing proposal or literature IDs for source claims. Keep a brief recap where needed for this section to stand alone, and preserve independent authorship and disagreement. Each target assessment has a concise headline stating core support and its principal unresolved issue; each finding has a readable title. The assessment explains what the audit establishes, its limits and the next resolving work. Optional statement_refs are exact JSON Pointers into that assessment's original proposal, never invented equation anchors. Define notation, delimit mathematics in mixed prose, and use readable labels and declared units. Keep exact science in its designated record and refer to exact supporting sources. Develop detailed reasoning once; use a brief consequence-focused recap and references elsewhere, preserving qualifications beside their claims and independent opinions. No extra summary artifacts, word quotas or presentation-only member turns are required. Within your permitted frozen read set, also assess whether the authored account directly answers its research question, faithfully describes its support and qualifications, and helps the researcher decide what to do next. Record misleading or missing explanation in the existing scientific findings with the affected source, consequence and resolving work. Do not claim review of later outputs or materials you cannot inspect. Consider the frozen researcher account of the target, observation and collection process, available information and performance expectations. Explain how relevant existing formulations and this model fit that setting. 1. Define the evaluation and choose the implementation route. Read the exact P2 model, researcher target and collection account, relevant P1 formulations, available aligned P3 results, prior implementation and saved instructions. Name target, units, population, intended use and material unknowns. Distinguish estimation, prediction and intervention questions. Inspect suitable shared Python/R packages and supplied/prior code. Choose package_reuse, package_adaptation or custom_implementation with rationale; record exact package/API/version/source, provided operations and missing pieces. Keep route separate from strategy=new/reuse_verified/adapt_verified, which describes prior-project lineage. First-run package use needs no prior project artifact. Supplied custom code remains custom code with its origin stated. Match equations, objective, preprocessing, tuning, prediction/estimation and uncertainty to the exact model; do not silently substitute a convenient method. Check the existing shared runtime and dependencies, distinguish denied access from absence, and report precise missing installation needs. Use machine/user-wide tools only. Draft a question-linked plan for verification, synthetic example, appropriate performance criteria, actual-data application, fair comparators, scenarios, independent repetitions, uncertainty, timing and stopping/resource allocation. Feasibility can be small; Detailed evaluation needs evidence adequate to its claims, with reasons for unassessed or inapplicable criteria rather than a fixed grid.
2. Deliver reusable code and an executable synthetic example. Write a documented Python/R model entrypoint that accepts data/configuration and returns estimates or predictions, diagnostics and failures. Package reuse supplies a thin driver, adaptation its adapter, and custom work standalone model code; a full installable package is optional. Keep fitting separate from generator, example configuration and demonstration runner. Retain support files, dependencies, actual runtime identity, ordinary invocation, input types/units, outputs and seed behavior in reproduction; it must work without provider credentials, run-directory paths, hidden harness state or required MODEL_FORGE_* variables. Describe the synthetic DGP mathematically, sampling/dependence/observation structure and known target; compute truth independently of fitting and qualify numerical approximations. Distinguish illustrative settings from confirmed researcher facts. Complete exact source pointers after writing bytes and save_plan before the first numerical batch; never invent a planned-file digest.
3. Verify the implementation. Use independent reference/invariant checks, fit the generated example, check dimensions/domains and relevant unsupported inputs, with prespecified tolerances. Run the exported bytes from a separate working directory through the managed runner with ordinary arguments. Save command, outcome and discrepancies. A smoke test supports execution/fidelity only. Repair ordinary code defects to the unambiguous frozen method and invalidate affected measurements while preserving attempts. A defective or ambiguous mathematical specification requires researcher direction.
4. Evaluate synthetic performance and apply to supplied actual data. Use verified code and justified scenarios. Match metrics to the target: known-truth estimation error, bias, empirical standard deviation and RMSE across independent datasets when applicable, distinguishing estimator variation from Monte Carlo standard error; held-out loss/calibration/discrimination for prediction; an appropriate effect target for intervention questions. Use fair paired baselines when material claims or researcher expectations require comparison; otherwise explain why comparison is inapplicable. Assess accuracy, uncertainty/reliability, computation, tuning and robustness as relevant in either scope. Distinguish independent generated datasets, one fixed dataset, resampling, splits and deterministic checks in cases. Bootstrap draws from one dataset are not independent simulation datasets. Report completed/failed/not-run full procedures and relevant internal fit failures, conditional denominators, interval-return, coverage among returned intervals and joint return-and-cover when assessed. Keep administratively unrun work separate. Quantify Monte Carlo uncertainty and paired differences where appropriate. Separate recorded preprocessing, fitting, tuning, uncertainty, full-procedure and total experiment timing; add only nonoverlapping components. Report solver convergence or trajectories only when recorded. Respect the frozen tuning rule; name out-of-rule variants as ablations or upstream proposals. Observed tuning selections alone are not a tuning-sensitivity experiment. Robustness changes a problem-relevant DGP or observation mechanism and states its consequence for the target; do not relabel repeated use of one DGP as robustness. For usable supplied actual data, map variables/units to the mathematical model, apply the same model interface, and report estimates or held-out predictive performance with diagnostics and applicability limits. Unknown actual truth cannot supply bias/RMSE or coverage, and predictive success cannot establish intervention identification. Use actual_data_application to record analyzed, supplied_not_analyzed with the reason, or not_supplied without inventing an actual-data case.

Answer every exact effective test_id once, including prospective and unassessed questions, then finish all eight analyst outputs and the handoff. Each answer states the direct finding, tested data origin/conditions, magnitude and units, usable counts, uncertainty, decisive limitation and decision consequence. Use the concrete table/figure templates in the prose contract: implementation discrepancy/tolerance; target estimation with bias and empirical SD when applicable, or held-out prediction for a prediction target; uncertainty return/coverage/width; recorded computation boundaries/convergence; tuning choices and any actually assessed sensitivity; changed-DGP robustness. Preserve an honest absence or unassessed explanation instead of inventing a metric, curve, convergence trace or sensitivity study. The protocol owns the synthetic DGP and simulation setup, and actual_data_application owns supplied-data disposition. Use the existing researcher-question.json only if an indispensable researcher editorial choice makes the next authorized reporting action unjustified: explain question and reason, set blocking=true with scope and source_refs, optionally options and conditional_scope, and stop after retaining partial work. Changed models, scientific targets and numerical scopes belong to new authorized upstream work. Do not use a native host question. Every relative file link and image in the report body must resolve to exactly one declared, digest-verified submitted material. Existing matching path/artifact_path aliases need no extra mapping. When a retained artifact's report-relative target differs from its supported aliases, use artifact_authored_paths keyed by that exact artifact_id, with one nonempty report-relative path string per artifact. Do not use arrays; additional copied scientific files need their own exact supplementary_artifacts declarations. Declare copied or generated scientific JSON, Markdown, code, figures and reproduction files in supplementary_artifacts with exact relative path, media_type and sha256; workspace existence alone does not make a file available to the reader or portable export. Check the unique source action and portable export for each body target. Published prior scientific assessments may be declared as scientific support; private researcher dialogue and current P5 parallel review findings are not outside submission materials. For a prose number stored inside a retained JSON artifact, source_refs names the exact-model P4 record generation/digest, pointer selects its artifact pointer, and scalar_pointer selects one finite JSON number inside that digest-verified artifact. Without scalar_pointer, pointer selects a numeric scalar directly in the frozen record. Do not replace an exact numerical source with a numeric-looking string, a paraphrase or a newly copied unchecked file. For each new researcher_decision author decision_priority as interpretation, inference, data or resources, using the highest material consequence in that order, and response_kind as choice or study_fact. Keep question to one current choice or exact factual request. context_markdown identifies the affected point with the minimum useful mathematics and locally defined symbols; likely_consequence gives its practical effect without repetition. For a choice, author options when a useful finite set exists, usually two or three realistic alternatives as {id,label,consequence} with unique IDs and actual benefits/costs. recommendation is Markdown Lead advice and reason, or the evidence needed before advice is justified; never preselect or save a recommendation as the researcher answer. A study_fact names the missing information, applicability limit and what can proceed while unknown, without options or recommendation. Inspect supplied material first. Do not repeatedly request unavailable facts during synthetic work. Consolidate duplicates while retaining independently answerable premises and exact scope/source/answer references. Carry forward only materially new consequences in the brief; retain derivations and earlier context through sources. No rigid word cap or separate rationale-writing checklist applies.

run_local_outputs.purpose: The readable Markdown+LaTeX primary report, exact model/context/source links, question-driven numerical support, claim dispositions, expectation outcomes and harness-derived interim/complete status; no venue fields or fixed phase claim counts.
Map central claims to exact supporting or contradicting literature, theory, and empirical records.
Record the exact frozen P1 through P4 identities, digests, authority states, and selected method identity used by the candidate technical_report.
Record citation resolution, unsupported citation attempts, and agreement between technical_report claims and the frozen literature library.
State the technical_report's scientific scope, active assumptions, unresolved issues, and limitations as a structured record.
Preserve stable specialist and outside-review issues with final dispositions; required in review-revision mode.

Record only indispensable researcher editorial choices needed to write this exact report; an empty array is valid. Retain the exact report/model scope, basis and answer applicability. Scientific questions, conflicting definitions and resolving team tasks remain in source records or the review ledger and route upstream; do not reopen P1-P4 elicitation.
State contribution, material changes, unresolved limitations, and possible user actions without claiming submission approval.
Explain major scientific and editorial choices in assembly mode.
Provide open mathematical and theory-to-implementation findings from the frozen technical_report, without lead dispositions.
Provide open implementation, evidence, reproducibility, statistical-interpretation, and implementation-to-theory findings from the frozen technical_report.

Provide an independent first-time-reader report with scope, missing materials, assessment, strengths, prioritized open findings, novelty-search boundary, and evidence that could change the assessment.
Link every issue disposition to the resulting technical_report change or scientific justification.

validation_rules.description: Exact published selected model and frozen problem context are required. Every used source resolves in the frozen basis; missing P3/P4 permits interim assembly.

The report primary Markdown artifact is retained and readable; exact sources and completion dispositions are verified. Complete status requires actual relevant numerical support for the exact model and appropriate justification or qualification for actual claims.
Each central claim resolves to current upstream support or is removed, narrowed, contradicted, or explicitly unresolved.

In review-revision, all reviews use one verified prepared packet and exact technical_report generation. Its separate instruction entry delivers the saved focus and frozen scope; corrections cannot rebuild it. Outside validation opens only this submission allowlist, never internal records or audits.
In review-revision, every unique specialist and reviewer issue receives a final disposition linked to the revision.
The complete technical_report package replaces the prior package atomically.

promotion.failure_behavior: Keep the previous report current on validation failure. A valid interim report may publish with derived missing work; manuscript history remains separate.

downstream_effects.description: A technical_report result may request upstream attention but never changes an upstream record or starts a run.
